**ANDERSEN CORPORATION SUMMARY:**

  

At Andersen, we see possibility everywhere, every day and in everything we do. The possibility for our employees to achieve their full potential, for our communities to be stronger and for everyone to have a healthier, happier place to live.

  

Our portfolio of brands — Andersen Windows & Doors, Renewal by Andersen and Fenetres MQ — is crafted to serve customers across the new residential, home improvement and light commercial building sector.

  

Join our more than 13,000 employees who are inspired every day to deliver exceptional experiences that turn possibility into reality.

  

**ANDERSEN CORPORATE VALUES:**

Each employee is responsible for upholding these values in their daily activities.

* **Humility: Lead with an open heart and mind.**
* **Ownership:** Take great pride in your work and know every decision you make has a lasting impact.
* **Meaningful connection:** You put relationships at the center of everything you do.
* **Expertise:** Set the standard and continue to raise the bar.

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

KML Windows Inc., a division of Andersen Corporation, is currently seeking a Process Engineering intern or co-op placement to assist our Engineering Department.  
  
This position entails project work with a responsibility for process and cost improvement suggestions, equipment set-up, and preparing technical documents in assigned production areas.

**Job Responsibilities:**This position will afford the successful applicant a full range of opportunities to complete projects, with required assistance, by a full-time group of engineers. The scope of the projects will only be limited by the candidate's ability.

**Required Skills:**. Post-secondary school education relevant to Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering  

* Minimum of two (2) co-op placements with on-the-job Engineering experience
* Demonstrated ability to complete projects from initial requests to implementation in a timely fashion
* Able to work independently or as a member of a team
* Proven strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Understanding of cost and time studies
* Strong mechanical aptitude
* Proficiency with AutoCAD/Inventor, Word, and Excel

**PAY RANGE:**

$21.10 - $31.66  

**CULTURE AND BENEFITS:**

At Andersen, we believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, their talent, dedication and passion enable us to be the most trusted window & door company. To support our employees, we provide a comprehensive Total Rewards Package – a thoughtful combination of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to investing in each team member’s wellbeing and success. While specific benefits may vary by position or location, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Package designed to support your well‑being, growth, and future. Our benefits include:

  

* Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan (DPSP) eligibility after 6 months
* Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) eligibility after 6 months, plus employer match
* Health & Dental Benefit Insurance
* Employee and Family Assistance Program
* Safety Shoe & Safety Glasses Benefits
* Life Insurance
* Paid Personal Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Career Growth Planning & Career Opportunities
* Employee Appreciation Events & Recognition Program

**PROFIT SHARING:**

In 2026 Andersen has set a profit-sharing target of $3,600 per eligible employee, prorated as appropriate. Profit Sharing will be paid out in quarterly installments to provide eligible employees with payments throughout the year, with payment amounts tied to quarterly operating profit performance.

*In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code, KML Windows Inc. will provide accommodation to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources staff of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require.*

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
The devices we make at SEL are embedded in the power grid. They prevent blackouts. They make outages safer and shorter in duration; they add cybersecurity, automation, and communication. They use cutting-edge technologies and operate at speeds that push other pieces of the grid to go faster. As an Electrical Engineering Intern in Engineering Services, you’ll provide solutions and services that help our customers protect and control critical electrical infrastructure and power systems worldwide. If you are a current student, this might be the ideal position for you.

**As an Engineering Intern, a typical day might include the following:**  
1. Provide technical support to SEL staff & customers.  
2. Develop and maintain knowledge in SEL processes and technologies.  
3. Perform testing on new and existing technology.  
4. Document and communicate test results.  
5. Follow and apply SEL Values, Principles of Operations, and World Class Manufacturing Principles.  
6. Understand. Create. Simplify.  
7. Other duties as assigned.  
  
**This position might be for you if you:**  
Experience in programming and script files  
Practical knowledge of 3-phase power systems  
Working knowledge of emulators and logic analyzers  
Ability to use MS Windows and serial port terminal emulation software  
Practical knowledge of SEL protective relays & automation controllers  
Ability to use Microsoft Visio  
Strong writing, documentation, and speaking skills  
Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities  
Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment  
Background check results satisfactory to SEL  
Negative drug test result(s)  
  
**About Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories**  
SEL designs, manufactures, and supports products and systems that protect, monitor, control, and automate electric power systems. Our technologies help detect faults, prevent equipment damage, and reduce the impact of power outages.  
Our mission is to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical. Employees contribute to practical, high-quality solutions used every day, where attention to detail and quality directly support the reliability of the electric grid.

**Location Information**  
This position could be located in Markham, ON, one of Canada’s most dynamic and diverse communities. Situated just north of Toronto, Markham offers the convenience of suburban living with easy access to world-class dining, entertainment, professional sports, and cultural attractions. Known for its strong technology sector, excellent schools, and vibrant neighborhoods, Markham is a great place to live and work.

This position could also be located in Calgary, AB, a vibrant city at the gateway to the Canadian Rockies. Known for its strong economy, diverse communities, and exceptional access to outdoor recreation, Calgary offers a high quality of life with a thriving downtown, professional sports, and year-round activities. With a blend of urban amenities and natural beauty, Calgary is an excellent place to live and work.

**Pay Range Data - 24.25$ CAD - 33.00$ CAD per hour**

Our intern pay is determined based on the internship role (the work you would be doing) and your year in school (when you plan to graduate). Talk to your recruiter if you are curious about the rate for your year in school.

jobs.title: Civil-Environmental Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**AECOM** is seeking a **Civil-Environmental Engineering Intern** for a **new role** to be based in our **Calgary, AB** office. The role is expected to start in **May 2027**.

This is a temporary internship designed to provide students with practical, hands-on experience that complements their academic studies and supports their transition from student to engineering professional. This position offers unique opportunities to work and explore work sites in Alberta and Canada’s North and experience fast pace and exciting environmental remediation assessment and construction projects.

**AECOM** works across Canada including in all three Canadian territories and frequently completes exciting projects requiring travel throughout the territories in float planes, helicopters, boats, ATVS, canoes, and more! The role also offers a wide variety of locally based field and office work, including but not limited to, groundwater and surface water sampling programs, landfill design and construction projects, and environmental site assessments and remediations.

The successful candidate will work alongside experienced engineers and environmental professionals, contributing to a variety of environmental assessment, construction, monitoring, and compliance projects across Western and Northern Canada.

**The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:**

* Support civil and environmental engineering and consulting projects through field and office-based assignments.
* Conduct field investigations and reporting for: environmental site assessments, remediation oversight, site inspections, and environmental monitoring activities under the supervision of senior staff.
* Utilize engineering principles, established procedures, and company standards to assist in solving routine environmental engineering challenges.
* Assist with preparation of drawings, specifications, and technical documents
* Review plans and shop drawings for compliance with project standards
* Support quality assurance and quality control processes
* Construction supervision and inspections.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve design and construction issues
* Prepare and provide daily construction reports.
* Measure and track construction quantities.
* Calculate grades, volumes, distances, etc.
* Support project scheduling and progress tracking
* Assist with the collection, interpretation, and organization of environmental data from soil, groundwater, surface water, and other environmental monitoring programs.
* Write and compile construction reports
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists, geologists, technologists, and project managers.
* Apply digital tools, mobile applications, databases, and geospatial technologies to support data collection and project delivery.
* Participate in project meetings, safety briefings, and ongoing professional development activities.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Requirements**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Willingness to travel to remote destinations for periods up to 2 weeks.
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites throughout Western and Northern Canada and surrounding regions as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Completion of at least the first year of an accredited post-secondary engineering program.
* Demonstrated interest in environmental consulting, remediation, hydrogeology, environmental assessment, water resources, or contaminated sites projects.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Comfortable working with technology, mobile field applications, databases, and environmental data management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in technical writing and report preparation.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Prior field experience through coursework, co-op, volunteer activities, research projects, or previous internships is considered an asset.
* Experience with CAD, GIS, environmental data analysis tools, or programming languages such as Python is considered an asset.

  
**Additional Information**  

* Relocation is not available for this position.
* Sponsorship for Canadian employment authorization is not available for this position.

Aecon delivers some of the most complex and impactful infrastructure projects — from transformative transportation networks to critical energy, industrial and nuclear programs. **What is the Opportunity?**

The Shoreline Power Group is a fully integrated Joint Venture of Aecon, and Atkinsrealis located in Kincardine, Ontario. Shoreline Power Group is the centerpiece of the Major Component Replacement (MCR) program which replaces the main components of 6 reactors at the Bruce Power Nuclear Generating Station. The scope of work includes the removal and replacement of calandria tubes, pressure tubes, and feeders as well as construction management and trade labor. This project is part of Bruce Power’s Life Extension Program, which will allow Bruce Power’s CANDU units to continue to operate safely through to 2064.

* Comfortable working with technology, mobile field applications, databases, and environmental data management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in technical writing and report preparation.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

This program is for individuals with high learning agility and willingness to adapt and develop continuously, who aim at consistently outperforming in a variety of settings and circumstances.

* Undergraduate entering third or fourth year.
* Pursing a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related from a recognized accredited college or university. **Candidates MUST be returning to full-time studies following this internship.**
* Record of high academic achievement (GPA 3.0 or higher preferred).
* Well-rounded applicants with leadership roles in student organizations or extra-curricular activities.
* Must be legally authorized to work full-time in the country of hire without requiring current or future sponsorship for employment.
* Candidates much demonstrate leadership potential, strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and oral communication skills, initiative, and problem-solving skill
  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

**This position will be a full-time, 16-month long internship opportunity. Candidates MUST be able to work the full 16-months at full-time capacity.**

**This job opportunity is fully onsite. There are no opportunities for remote work. Candidates MUST be in commutable distance from the facility located at 1 Gerdau Court in Whitby, ON.**

  

* Implement improvements to plant drawing management system
* Support plant Management of Change initiatives
* Execute and support plant improvement projects (CapEx and OpEx)
* Develop equipment maintenance plans
* Identify spare part requirements & support storeroom optimization efforts
* Coordinate the management of maintenance documents (Manuals, Drawings, Technical Specifications) Some Engineering Design and Drafting Leadership Skills:
* Introduction to project management, working collaboratively between departments, with contactors and management
* Introduction to managing a process in a unionized heavy manufacturing facility.
* The opportunity to train the incoming intern in 2027 as they hand off their responsibilities and transfer part of their learnings.
* Software: Microsoft suite, SAP, AutoDesk suite, etc.
